diagnosis: The V11 partial loop was not a browser-capability problem in the owner CI runner. The source-to-served cut was incomplete: data-layer.js was stale on gh-pages, and after that was repaired fresh Chromium evidence exposed ingress-v1.js as a second stale member. Independent gh-pages writers made single content updates unreliable. The existing V11 served CI already had the correct browser owner and hardened identity gate, but lacked an atomic bounded no-force publication step for the identity-critical V11 cut.
intervention: Reused .github/workflows/mp10-v11-served-browser-ci-v1.yml as the existing source-change publication/verification loop. Added bounded no-force publication that rebuilds each attempt from the latest origin/gh-pages and commits the V11 candidate cut atomically. First runtime proved v11.js + data-layer.js identity and surfaced stale ingress-v1.js; a preservation addendum then extended the same atomic cut and gate to ingress-v1.js only. No workflow, branch, scheduler, queue, CURRENT, planner, provider or worker family was added.
